name: 241. Client tool_use named web_search/web_fetch stays a function_call (#8078 / PR #8079)
description: Regression for #8078 / PR #8079. A client (function) tool_use named web_search or web_fetch was converted to a web_search_call / web_fetch_call because the grouped Anthropic converter matched on name only, orphaning its tool_result. Bedrock rejected the replay with 'The number of toolResult blocks ... exceeds the number of toolUse blocks of previous turn'. Each case replays an assistant turn with client tool_use blocks named web_search and web_fetch plus the matching tool_results through /anthropic/v1/messages and expects a successful reply.

item.name: bedrock/global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 /anthropic/v1/messages replay of client tool_use named web_search/web_fetch keeps tool_result paired - #8078

exec: pm.test('Client web_search/web_fetch tool_use replay is not orphaned - #8078', function () {
pm.expect(body, 'tool_result orphaned: client tool_use was converted to a server tool call').to.not.include('exceeds the number of toolUse blocks');

body.raw: {"model":"bedrock/global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":64,"tools":[{"name":"web_search","description":"Client-defined search function","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"}}}},{"name":"web_fetch","description":"Client-defined fetch function","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"url":{"type":"string"}}}}],"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Search for bifrost and fetch https://example.com, then summarize in one word."},{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_client_ws","name":"web_search","input":{"query":"bifrost"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_client_wf","name":"web_fetch","input":{"url":"https://example.com"}}]},{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_client_ws","content":"Bifrost is an AI gateway."},{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_client_wf","content":"Example Domain"}]}]}
